subject: the Tigris and Euphrates
names: Framework Agreement on Cooperation in the Field of Water Policy

facts.statement: Under a 1987 protocol Turkey undertook to release an average flow of the Euphrates at its border with Syria.
facts.source: Oregon State University, Program in Water Conflict Management and Transformation: Euphrates-Tigris case study

facts.statement: Under a 1990 agreement Syria and Iraq share the Euphrates water entering Syria from Turkey; Iraq’s share.
facts.source: UNEP LEAP: Joint Minutes concerning the provisional division of the waters of the Euphrates

facts.statement: Turkey began filling the reservoir of the Atatürk Dam on the Euphrates in January 1990.
facts.source: Oregon State University, Program in Water Conflict Management and Transformation: Euphrates-Tigris case study

facts.statement: Turkey began filling the reservoir of the Ilısu Dam on the Tigris in July 2019.
Türkiye and Iraq signed the Framework Agreement on Cooperation in the Field of Water Policy on 22 April 2024.
facts.source: Directorate of Communications, Presidency of the Republic of Türkiye
